title: Our Project Suncatcher prototype satellite is in orbit.
author: Travis Beals
summary_raw: Google's prototype satellite for Project Suncatcher, built in partnership with Planet, launched into orbit aboard the Transporter-18 rideshare mission with SpaceX.
